title: Concept: Link header points at a plaintext origin
description: A Link header on an https response names an http:// target. Resource hints are acted on before the page finishes loading: a preconnect opens a cleartext connection and a preload fetches the asset, so metadata and possibly content are exposed on the path even though the document was encrypted.
applicability: HTTPS responses that emit Link preconnect, preload or stylesheet hints.
risk: Cleartext metadata or asset fetch on the connection the hint opens; LOW severity because the fetched resource is usually public.
